finiteEnvironment.scheduling: Every declared legal action is enabled freely; no scenario routing; no fairness or unbounded liveness claim.

traceContract.normalization: Unique last-:: suffixes; exact fixed owner domain; safe integers only.

fast.tlc: Complete finite exploration of all three explicitly stated configurations.
fast.claim: Bounded Apalache to depth 6 for each labelled domain; complete TLC checks are independent.

deep.tlc: Same complete finite domains; bounded result is an independent deeper run.
deep.claim: Optional separate depth 9/8/8 run; initial deep exploratory run was incomplete, so no deep evidence is established by fast success.

exclusions: Unbounded starts, arbitrary records/text, arbitrary pause/resume repetition

The complete 2-owner domain permits one provider PCM per owner; the complete 3-owner ABA domain permits only A/startPosition1/start-unpaused, no PCM/seek/record switch. Wider 3-owner/2-PCM witnesses are fixed reachability plus implementation replay, not complete exploration.
Provider zero-audio/failure semantics, arbitrary sample rates, arbitrary network frame batching
Unicode, long text, normalization and rewrite boundaries use separate real implementation contracts
Actual uint32 and safe-integer numeric boundaries use separate implementation tests
Qwen response-ID binding/history bounds use separate real WebSocket tests; model covers browser frame ownership
No browser or audible quality, hardware/device latency, live provider quality, crash or durable recovery claim
No temporal liveness or fairness theorem; terminal witnesses require eventual unlock, successful provider delivery, render and settlement; indefinite pause is legal waiting
